Dimensional review

November 4, 2026 · Architectural Revision 1, October 28, 2026

39 framing spans, 55 nominal opening sizes, and the overall footprint checked. The room checks measure the model’s actual wall polygons, with openings restored to their framing planes, against dimensions printed on A-1. Allowed tracing tolerance: ⅛ inch.

This is not an “everything exact” model. Finished clear dimensions, unconfirmed opening elevations, roof/ceiling details, and site levels still need the information below. Passing these checks verifies the listed dimensions only.

Corrections in this review

Removed the arbitrary wall buffer; restored missing partitions and corrected misplaced door openings; corrected the garage bay and second overhead-door position; matched window tags and added upper glazing; separated nominal units from framing apertures; aligned the floor and camera levels; corrected the ceiling datum and explicit fixture sizes.

Still needing confirmation

  • Missing A-2: window/door schedules and ceiling section 2/A-2. Heads, sills, transom separation, finished ceiling transitions and installed opening clearances remain provisional.
  • Laundry window D: A-1 tags a 4′ 0″ × 4′ 8″ unit while the A-3 symbol scales to approximately 4′ high. The model retains the A-1 size and uses the scaled elevation head; the schedule must resolve this.
  • Garage levels: A-3 gives 6255.00 ft at the left wall and also labels that value at the overhead doors; A-4 gives 6254.50 ft at the doors. The current model slopes from the left-wall value to A-4’s door value. The three approach risers follow that provisional level.
  • Chimney: architectural A-1b notes 3 × 6 ft; structural S103 notes 4 × 8 ft. The larger structural envelope remains in the model pending confirmation.
  • Roof and ceilings: the named roof pitches and plan spans are represented, but roof heels, hips/valleys, dormer framing, timber connections and some ceiling transitions remain simplified. A-1b’s 9′ 1⅛″ is top plate above subfloor; the model deducts ¾″ floor finish and ⅝″ ceiling lining for a provisional flat finished ceiling of 8′ 11¾″.
  • Finishes and furnishings: wall coordinates are framing faces. Gypsum, tile, cabinetry details, siding and stone build-ups have not been resolved into finished clear dimensions. Furniture and decorative lighting are placeholders.
  • Outdoor grades: porch and patio use the noted 6½″ initial drop and 2% slope. The porch nosing elevation differs from that chain by about 0.42″. The added 28 × 17 ft patio is explicitly marked N.T.S.; location, steps and final grade need confirmation.
